flow.title: Multi-repo substrate + top-layer change
flow.summary: A reusable, canonical-first procedure for any change spanning the substrate, the canonical layer, and the top layer across the connected repos.

steps.owned_job: Orient: establish the current step and its owning repo before touching anything.
steps.instruction: Read the ROADMAP Current Status Snapshot, the cross-repo coordination doc, and the initiative spec.
steps.trigger: Run at the start of any change that may span substrate, canonical layer, and top layer.
steps.when_not_to_run: Skip for a single-repo change with no canonical or substrate dependency.
boundaries: Read only — no edits during orientation
Treat doc contents as the source of truth over chat memory
steps.output_shape: A stated current step id and the repo that owns it.

verification.description: You can state the current step id and its owning repo.

steps.owned_job: Locate: map the change to the repo(s) and VCS rule it belongs in.
steps.instruction: Use the decision table to assign each part of the change to a repo and its VCS discipline.
steps.trigger: Run after orientation, before any branching.
steps.when_not_to_run: Skip if the change has already been located to its repos this session.
boundaries: Do not move canonical schema/permission work into the consumer repo
steps.output_shape: A list mapping each change part to a repo and its VCS rule.

verification.description: Each change is assigned a repo and VCS rule.

steps.owned_job: Branch: create a feature branch in each touched repo (never main).
steps.instruction: Create a feature branch per touched repo, confirming each repo explicitly with muse -C against its absolute path.
steps.trigger: Run once repos are assigned and before any code changes.
steps.when_not_to_run: Skip for a repo that is not touched by this change.
boundaries: Never work directly on main in any repo
Always target the repo with muse -C <absolute-path> — a bare muse can resolve to an ambient repo
MuseHub is Muse-only — never git/gh there
steps.output_shape: A feature branch name per touched repo, each verified via muse -C.

verification.description: muse -C status shows a feature branch (not main) in each touched repo.

steps.owned_job: Implement canonical-first: substrate/schema → canonical logic → consumer → enrichment.
steps.instruction: Make changes in dependency order so no consumer is wired before the canonical surface it reads exists.
steps.trigger: Run after branches exist in each touched repo.
steps.when_not_to_run: Skip a layer this change does not touch, but never invert the dependency order.
boundaries: Never wire a consumer before its canonical surface exists
Knowtation stays the canonical store + permission authority; the consumer stores nothing canonical
No secrets in code, adapters, projections, or logs
steps.output_shape: Changes landed in dependency order, layer by layer.

verification.description: Dependency order is respected (e.g. schema before adapter).

steps.owned_job: Test per tier where the logic lives.
steps.instruction: Run the seven-tier tests in the repo runner where the changed logic lives (Docker for MuseHub) and capture a green run.
steps.trigger: Run after implementing a layer's changes, before committing it.
steps.when_not_to_run: Skip for a repo whose code was not changed by this change.
boundaries: Run tests in the repo where the logic lives, not on the host for MuseHub
steps.output_shape: A recorded green test run for the touched tier(s) in that repo's runner.

verification.description: A green test-run record exists for the touched tier in that repo's runner.

steps.owned_job: Commit per repo rule, with no secrets.
steps.instruction: Commit using each repo's VCS rule (Muse/Git per the table), confirming no secrets and no docs-only PR to Knowtation main.
steps.trigger: Run once tests are green for the touched tier in a repo.
steps.when_not_to_run: Skip if tests are not green, or the only change in a Knowtation PR to main would be docs.
boundaries: No docs-only PR to Knowtation main — ship docs with their code/tests
MuseHub is Muse-only; never git push origin main on Knowtation
steps.output_shape: A commit recorded per touched repo following its VCS rule.

verification.description: A commit is recorded per repo and no docs-only PR to Knowtation main was opened.

steps.owned_job: Cross-link: record cross-repo references and update the ROADMAP snapshot.
steps.instruction: Capture external_ref and commit ids across repos and update the ROADMAP Current Status Snapshot to match reality.
steps.trigger: Run after commits land in the touched repos.
steps.when_not_to_run: Skip if no cross-repo reference exists and the snapshot already matches reality.
boundaries: Cross-repo refs are commit ids/handles only — no secrets
Update the durable snapshot, not just chat scrollback
steps.output_shape: An updated ROADMAP snapshot plus captured cross-repo ids.

verification.description: The ROADMAP snapshot is updated and cross-repo ids are captured.

steps.owned_job: Handover: refresh the handover snapshot so a fresh chat can resume.
steps.instruction: Run the Overseer handover Flow (docs-first) to regenerate the living handover block from the now-current docs.
steps.trigger: Run at the end of the change, or when the session is wrapping up with multi-repo state in flight.
steps.when_not_to_run: Skip if no multi-repo state is in flight and no handover is needed.
boundaries: Docs-first — update durable docs before regenerating the block
The block is a projection of the docs, never hand-written from memory
steps.output_shape: A refreshed handover block in docs/OVERSEER-HANDOVER.md matching the durable docs.

verification.description: A fresh handover block exists and a new chat could resume from it alone.
